title: Loyalty points awarded twice for the same transaction
incident_report: The loyalty service sometimes awards points twice for a single transaction id when an event is redelivered. The earn endpoint is not de-duplicating by transaction.
symptoms: points balance doubled for one transaction
two earn ledger entries with the same transaction id
expected_root_cause: earn is not idempotent; it does not check whether an EARN ledger entry already exists for the transaction before awarding
